audit.method: Static audit of the local Bitwig 5.3.13 install and of every crate in the Hikaru OpenLive workspace.

areas.name: Clip Launcher
areas.bitwig_reference: Clip Launcher, scenes, clip slots and launch quantization (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: MIDI note preview inside clip slots
Take-over mode and per-clip launch settings

areas.name: Arranger
areas.bitwig_reference: Arranger timeline, clip editing, loop region and arrangement tools (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Arrangement markers
features.note: Loop markers are functional; the general marker lane is missing.

features.name: Clip fades
features.note: Fade handles are not exposed in the arranger.

features.name: Clip gain envelope
features.note: Per-clip Gain expression curve with tension nodes and real-time audio engine evaluation.

features.name: Clip stretch handles on the timeline

areas.name: Transport & Sync
areas.bitwig_reference: Transport, tempo, musical time and synchronization (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Master clock shared with the audio engine
Punch in/out
features.note: Flags are present, recording behaviour is not.

areas.name: Group Tracks & Routing
areas.bitwig_reference: Recursive group tracks, track types, monitoring and signal routing (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Parent color rail and nesting indent
Routing matrix UI
features.note: Destinations are modeled, the full matrix is not exposed.

areas.name: Time-stretching & Audio
areas.bitwig_reference: Audio playback, warping and time-stretching (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Real-time streaming stretch
features.note: Stretch is precomputed into a buffer; the streaming path is partial.

features.name: Automatic warp to project tempo
features.note: Warp markers exist; automatic beat-grid warping is partial.

areas.name: Built-in Devices & FX
areas.bitwig_reference: All 150 native .bwdevice plug-ins shipped with Bitwig Studio 5.3.13 (instruments, audio FX, note FX, Grid and utilities).

features.name: Filter+
features.note: Hikaru exposes the base device; the extended Bitwig variant is partial.

features.name: Phaser+
features.note: Hikaru OpenPhaser+ (GS / EHx / MX / MF multi-model TPT phaser with Color, FB, Speed, Depth, Polarity Invert, Stereo and Mix).

areas.name: Modulators
areas.bitwig_reference: All 43 native .bwmodulator modules shipped with Bitwig Studio 5.3.13.

areas.name: Grid Devices
areas.bitwig_reference: 228 native Grid modules (.bwmodule) from Bitwig Studio 5.3.13 (Poly Grid / FX Grid / Note Grid).

areas.name: Mixer & I/O
areas.bitwig_reference: Mixer channel strips, master section, routing and audio device I/O (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: Browser & Files
areas.bitwig_reference: Pop-up browser, content filters, file explorer, presets and project files (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: MIDI & Controllers
areas.bitwig_reference: MIDI editing, hardware controllers, MIDI learn, MPE and sync (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: MIDI clip scheduling in the audio engine
Drum-pad mode in the piano roll

areas.name: UI & Workflow
areas.bitwig_reference: Look, layout, panels, menus and workflow of Bitwig Studio 5.3.13.

areas.name: Build & Platform
areas.bitwig_reference: Platform support, packaging and release engineering expected from a Bitwig Studio 5.3.13 replacement.

areas.name: VST3 & CLAP
areas.bitwig_reference: VST3 and CLAP plugin hosting: scanning, audio/MIDI processing, native editor embedding, parameter automation, polyphonic modulation, sidechain routing and sandboxing (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: Automation
areas.bitwig_reference: Automation lanes, envelopes, write modes (touch/latch/write), clip automation and tempo automation (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Automation lane display/editing
features.note: A show_automation flag and automation persistence exist; there is no full editing lane yet.

features.name: Tempo / time-signature lane
features.note: Global tempo and signature exist; arrangement automation is not implemented.

features.name: Clip automation envelopes
features.note: Audio clip expression curves (Gain, Pan, Pitch, Formant) with tension nodes and real-time playback evaluation.

features.name: Tempo automation
features.note: Master -> Transport -> Tempo automation curve (20.00..666.00 BPM) with live playback evaluation.

areas.name: .DAWproject
areas.bitwig_reference: Open DAWproject (.dawproject) interchange format: ZIP container, transport, tracks, audio/MIDI clips, automation, devices and scenes (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Track structure, color, volume, pan & mute

areas.name: .bwproject
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio project file (.bwproject) import/compatibility (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: .bwtemplate
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio project template (.bwtemplate) import/compatibility (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: .bwdevice
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio device & preset container (.bwdevice) import/compatibility (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Nested device chains, layers & FX racks
Grid patch graph & browser preset loading

areas.name: .bwpreset
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio device, rack and Grid preset container (.bwpreset, BtWg00030002) (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Device parameter values & macro state import

areas.name: .bwclip
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio clip container (.bwclip): MIDI/audio/hybrid clips, automation & launcher metadata (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Audio clip, warp markers & embedded media

areas.name: .bwmodulator
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio modulator container (.bwmodulator, BtWg00030004) for the 43 built-in modulators (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: .bwmodule
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio Grid module container (.bwmodule, BtWg00030004) for the 228 Grid modules (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: BtWg00030004 Grid module container & UUID resolver (.bwmodule)

areas.name: .bwremotecontrols
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio remote control page mappings (.bwremotecontrols, BtWg00030002) (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: .bwextension
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio compiled controller extension package (.bwextension) (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: .bwpackage
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio Sound Package & content library bundle (.bwpackage) (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Sample, preset & clip asset indexing in Browser

areas.name: .multisample
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio Sampler multisample instrument container (.multisample) (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Key zones, velocity layers & loop points

areas.name: .wt
areas.bitwig_reference: Native Bitwig Studio wavetable format (.wt) for Sampler, Polymer and Grid oscillators (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

areas.name: .nitro
areas.bitwig_reference: Internal Bitwig Studio Nitro DSP graph format (.nitro / .nitrobin) used inside .bwdevice and .bwmodule (Bitwig Studio 5.3.13).

features.name: Nitro DSP graph / bytecode format analysis (.nitro/.nitrobin)
